name: Chronos Lite
about: What Chronos Lite is, as numbers the runtime holds and scripts/check-edition.mjs asserts. Lite means smaller, not the light theme: anything new either replaces something or takes a slot under these caps.
sizeL: downgraded to m with a note, never refused outright
cardLock: the full Chronos home's run/gpu.lock (CHRONOS_HOME, else ~/.chronos): shared with every Chronos on this computer

service.ui: static files under ui/ at /, when ui/ is there

hiredBy: Hephaestus, as a wisp only: POST /quests, then GET /events?since=n replayed from an in-memory ring
